categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of magnesium alloy and aluminum alloy precision die-casting products and supporting die-casting molds. Main products include automotive lighting heat dissipation brackets, automotive seat armrest components, new energy vehicle powertrain components, automotive center console parts, and high-cleanliness autonomous driving module components. The company also produces products for electric bicycles and garden machinery applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes precision die-casting and machining manufacturing technologies. Core technologies include crack-prevention forming technology, localized pressure forming technology, ejection anti-deformation control technology, magnesium alloy electrostatic spraying technology, magnesium alloy melting protection technology, magnesium ash removal technology, magnesium alloy dust collection and purification control technology, large flat surface and thin-wall deformation-resistant casting processing technology, and complex tool design and application technology. The company also employs semi-solid magnesium alloy injection molding technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major automotive manufacturers and new energy vehicle companies including Ford, Volkswagen, Audi, BMW, Nissan, Tesla, Nio, XPeng, and domestic brands like FAW Red Flag, SAIC, and Changan. Products are primarily supplied to Tier 1 and Tier 2 automotive suppliers. The company also serves electric bicycle manufacturers and garden machinery tool producers. Primary end markets are automotive (traditional and new energy vehicles), electric bicycles, and garden machinery.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province. The company has established a subsidiary in Fenghua, Zhejiang Province and is establishing a production base in Thailand. Domestic operations are concentrated in the Ningbo area, while international business includes exports to North America, Europe, and other regions. The company is expanding its global footprint through overseas production facilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures precision die-casting components and molds that are supplied to Tier 1 and Tier 2 automotive suppliers, which then supply to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs). The company also directly supplies some components to automotive manufacturers. It sources raw materials (magnesium and aluminum alloys) from upstream suppliers and provides finished products to downstream customers in the automotive supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on magnesium alloy lightweight applications in automotive and new energy vehicle sectors. Key R&D initiatives include: developing large and medium-sized magnesium alloy automotive components, advancing semi-solid forming technology for automotive applications, developing new energy vehicle powertrain system components, expanding high-cleanliness autonomous driving module components, and improving magnesium alloy material performance and processing costs. The company emphasizes collaborative design with OEMs and continuous technology innovation to maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of precision die-casting products (magnesium alloy and aluminum alloy components) and die-casting molds. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of the products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates on a made-to-order basis for most products, with some advance production for inventory. Pricing is determined through competitive bidding and negotiation with customers, with some products subject to annual price reduction clauses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading manufacturer in the magnesium alloy precision die-casting sector in China. It holds the status of a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise and is recognized as a key backbone enterprise in China's die-casting mold industry. The company has early-mover advantages in magnesium alloy die-casting and maintains competitive advantages through superior technology, integrated production capabilities, and established relationships with major automotive manufacturers. Competitors include other precision die-casting manufacturers, though the company's specialization in magnesium alloys provides differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 operating revenue of approximately 352.2 million yuan, representing 30.16% growth compared to 2022 (270.6 million yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 80.1 million yuan in 2023, up 42.42% from 56.2 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 1.14 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with consistent year-over-year revenue and profit increases, supported by expanding automotive market demand and new product development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through: (1) advanced magnesium alloy precision die-casting technology developed over 15+ years, enabling complex, lightweight, high-precision components; (2) integrated one-stop service covering mold design, die-casting, precision machining, surface treatment, and quality inspection; (3) superior quality control systems and advanced manufacturing equipment; (4) collaborative design capabilities with OEMs for optimized lightweight solutions; (5) semi-solid forming technology for large automotive structural components; and (6) established relationships with leading global automotive manufacturers, providing reliability and supply chain stability advantages.
